claims.text: The rider's only message in the waiting window — 'coming down now', sent at 10:18:53 and read by the driver at 10:19:23 — is a coordinating message: it tells the driver the rider is on her way down to the pickup. The driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of it (120 seconds after 10:18:53 is 10:20:53, and his last and only message was at 10:16:58, before hers) and placed no in-app voice call — trip_record.in_app_calls is empty — before cancelling at 10:23:23, some 270 seconds after her message. Limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04 are therefore made out on this record: the rider did the coordinating the clause asks of her, and the failed pickup is the conduct of a driver who was reading her message and said nothing.

The rider cannot carry limb (c) of POL-NS-04 and does not ask the judge to stretch it: the derived rider track places the rider's device roughly 850 m from the pickup pin for every fix in the window and reports zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, so the majority-of-qualifying-fixes test is not satisfied on the rider's side. Under POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-11 the clause therefore cannot exonerate the rider, and the driver's unanswered message — real as that coordination failure is — does not by itself displace the fee.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup: EV-ADVIS-03305-01 is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0, and the rider discloses that impairment, as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. Under POL-NS-06 limb (i) an advisory that is not present and populated makes accumulation and extension unavailable, so the waiting clock cannot be extended and separate in-geofence intervals cannot be summed, and the driver's required minimum dwell for this STANDARD pickup stays the 180-second free waiting period in force under POL-NS-01(c).

Neither route to escalation under POL-NS-09(d) opens on this record, and the rider states that plainly rather than pressing it: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d of 4 meets the count limb of the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check, but the rate limb does not — 4 over driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 60 is 0.067, not greater than the 0.08 the clause requires — and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 that limb names.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The SGD 4.50 no-show fee stands, and SGD 3.60 of it is paid to the driver; you, the rider, receive no refund.

WHY THE FEE STANDS (POL-NS-01). All four conditions are on the record. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 10:16:33. (b) The GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that moment: the first qualifying in-geofence fix is stamped 10:16:33 with dwell start offset 0.0, his closest fix is 0.0 m from the pin, and 42 of his 86 fixes qualify inside the radius - far past the three consecutive fixes POL-NS-02 requires. (c) He then held position continuously inside the geofence for 410 seconds (10:16:33 to 10:23:23), measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires, against the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip. That is a surplus of 230 seconds, not a shortfall. (d) No boarding event is recorded, and the driver terminated the trip at 10:23:23 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed.

YOUR ACCOUNT, RIDER. 'Only a few minutes late' does not describe this record. Your own device track runs roughly 850 m from the pickup pin for the whole window (minimum 848.5 m, mean 852.3 m) and contains no fix inside the 100 m rider-presence radius. Your message at 10:18:53 ('coming down now') was a genuine coordinating message, and the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed an in-app call before cancelling - POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are made out. But POL-NS-04 exonerates a rider only where limb (c) also holds, and limb (c) fails affirmatively on your own admissible fixes: you were not at the pin. On its own terms the clause does not apply, and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01.

THE OTHER CLAUSES. POL-NS-05 does not fire: the 'I'm Here' tap is not a false marker - at that moment the driver was inside the radius and stationary, not more than 300 m away nor at 15 km/h or more - so the clock is the platform's, not a recomputed one, and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-06 gives you nothing: the dwell is a single continuous 410-second interval with no shortfall to excuse, and the only traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-03305-01) is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so limb (i) accumulation is unavailable in any event. POL-NS-03 does not apply, because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius rather than outside it. No POL-NS-08 integrity defect exists: no clock skew, no trace gap (100% coverage, max gap 0 s), the chat log matches the trip record's message count, and the fare line of SGD 4.50 reconciles with the SGD 4.50 figure in the platform policy. Nothing engages POL-NS-09: neither counterparty counter reaches 2, rider no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below 3), and no artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence.

THE DRIVER'S PAYOUT (POL-NS-07). 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee is SGD 3.60, the residual 20 percent being the platform service fee, and the fare ledger's own derived figure agrees. The anti-farming check does not withhold it: no_show_terminations_30d is 4, so the count limb is met, but 4 divided by 60 completed trips is 0.067, not greater than the 0.08 the clause requires, and both limbs must trip. The lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is not the field that check reads and is not relied on.

OUTCOME. Under POL-GEN-03 the rider's claim is not supported and the charge stands, while on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60 as driver_compensation_sgd - it is the amount the ruling moves, not a refund to the filing party. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically. No referral is produced, because no clause on these facts adds one. Confidence 0.9: the deciding facts are carried by the GPS trace, trip record, chat log and fare ledger, each at weight 1.0.
